protocol.selection: lowest mean final validation cross entropy across seeds; ties: fewer parameters, name
protocol.test_usage: final evaluation of all prespecified candidates after selection; no retuning
protocol.seed_variation: initialization and minibatch order, fixed data split

limits: Small easy historical dataset; no production or population-generalization claim.
Three seeds on one split do not estimate data-sampling uncertainty.
No group/time metadata: exact duplicate and row checks cannot exclude latent leakage.
Equal sample/update budgets do not mean equal FLOPs or wall time.
Uncalibrated softmax scores are not reliability guarantees.
Assistant-generated evidence does not establish independent learner mastery.
